comment: Larak Lot surface classes (wave 4 lane D). Each class tile is 64 x 64 at 16 texels per metre, a 4 m patch, prepared by tools/prepare_surface_tiles.gd from one Higgsfield seed native-reduced to 128 (the specs below). Ramp steps are palette.json keys or blends of two keys [a, b, t] (lore-gate P10: extension, pending Nick). Shares are the fraction of the tile each step takes, darkest first, assigned by luminance rank: one broad field step carries most of the tile and the steps either side of it, a few percent of value apart, are its clusters, so every class keeps a known, quiet value whatever the generator's exposure. Accents replace the most saturated warm pixels, up to their share.

classes.use: walking decks: the swept cast concrete of every level, evenly mottled so a 4 m repeat carries no motif
tall concrete: the shell, columns and screens, streaked by years of leaks
steel treads, steps, the Bridge and the valet barriers: raised lugs worn pale on the walking line
the shear walls and the Low Ramp screen: heavier structure, darker, a tie-hole grid
low faces up to 1.6 m: deck edges, retaining faces and the seat kerbs, with tyre rub along the base; sampled from the tile's bottom rows in 1.5 m deck bands
the Pit floor: the bays that fell in, damp broken slab under the lightwell
